name: bespunky-project-starter
description: Deprecated: renamed to bespunky-house. Nothing to learn - your next /bespunky-project-starter:sync installs bespunky-house@claude-toolkit at the same scope and runs its upgrade, which is what /sync became (adding a layer is now /bespunky-house:add-layer, creating a project /bespunky-house:new). Then `claude plugin uninstall bespunky-project-starter`. Or install bespunky-house yourself now.
